$comment: The machine-readable answer to 'what is happening now?'. It is not a historical database: completed stages are ids only, and the narrative for anything closed lives in Git. docs/ROADMAP.md sequences; this file states.
currentStage: Phase 4D — Visual direction, responsive composition and candidate promotion
blockedBy: A second genuine business, and the approval that makes one usable. The remaining Phase 4D question is whether the factory can clear 8.5 on richer approved material, and it cannot be asked of nbm: docs/GENUINE_BUSINESS_ACCEPTANCE.md requires at least one genuine user-supplied company document, logo, image or spreadsheet explicitly approved for use, and states that public visibility is not republication permission. That approval is an act by a business owner. No amount of building produces it, and manufacturing one would fail the gate by construction - a generated pack passed off as supplied business material is named in 'What does not count'.
outstandingProductGates: phase-4d-candidate-rework-v2: two independent verdicts over the same frozen nbm inputs, kept at examples/genuine-business/nbm-visual-review-v{1,2}.verdicts.json. v1 rejected both candidates (5.21 and 4.66) over evidence in which six routes were photographed as one page. v2, after the capture fix, scores 6.14 and 5.91 and returns rework on both. The pair measures the split: visual-hierarchy, credibility and coherence recovered by one to two points and now clear the floor, which was the invalid evidence; distinctiveness (4.8, 4.8), distinctive-moment (4.6, 3.5) and responsive-quality (5.9, 4.6) barely moved, which is the output. The two responsive defects the reviewer named are now fixed and measured on a real build: a closing call to action is no longer hoisted above page content on a phone, and the scrolling navigation row went from three of five destinations hidden to one. Distinctiveness and the distinctive moment are untouched and are what a third candidate has to answer.

phase-4-2a-static-visual-review: the genuine nbm business renders through the static/content renderer as an independent repository with zero client JavaScript and six route documents. `npm run acceptance:static-renderer` leaves the evidence at .app-builder/static-renderer and stops. A reviewer who did not produce it must say whether the static rendering is at least as good as the application-rendered one before 4.2A closes.

professional-output-independent-verdict: the one outstanding row in docs/VISUAL_EXCELLENCE.md §9. It is the same gate three times over, because a candidate set, a static rendering and any bespoke presentation each need a reviewer who did not produce the work.

nbm-source-pack-ceiling: the frozen nbm case may not be able to reach the 8.5 bar without fabricating facts, and that is a corpus finding rather than a factory defect. Both independent reviews ask for the same missing material - project experience, credentials, qualifications, sectors, team information, client outcomes, process - and buildContract.explicitlyExcluded forbids exactly that: named client or project case studies, republished photographs, and any performance, client, award, accreditation or experience claim no approved source supports. The approved pack is a company name, one registry sentence, four service names with no descriptions, two location names with no detail, one phone number and one address; entities is empty. A typography and layout led direction has a ceiling on that much content and no art direction raises it. Decide deliberately whether the bar is proved on a richer business, whether the owner can approve more nbm material, or whether the bar is wrong for a business this thinly evidenced. Do not close the gap by inventing proof. Measured on the 2026-08-28 rerun: the factory itself now quantifies part of this. The candidate generator REFUSED the immersive-lead direction outright - 'imagery-not-available ... No photographs were supplied at all, so the direction has to carry the page with type and layout' - and assetReadiness records strategy 'typography-led' with supportsImageryLed false. One of three visual directions is unreachable for this business on rights grounds alone, before any judgement of taste. That is a source ceiling the factory measures rather than an opinion about it, and it is the first row of the source-adequacy evidence a second business is needed to turn into a relationship. One row is not a mechanism; do not build a SourceAdequacy subsystem on it.

phase-4d-richer-business-input: the experiment Phase 4D now needs is the complete candidate flow on a genuine business with materially richer approved truth, so a poor score can be attributed to the factory rather than to the source pack. The repository holds exactly one genuine business - nbm - and no second approved-intake bundle, ingested pack or durable project exists anywhere in it. What is missing is not code. It is a real company's supplied material plus an explicit rights approval, which is the entry condition every corpus case in docs/GENUINE_BUSINESS_ACCEPTANCE.md has to meet. Obtain one business from the corpus list - local trade with project photography is the easiest to source and the furthest from nbm - and freeze it in the shape examples/genuine-business/nbm-approved-intake.v1.json already defines. Until that exists the visual bar cannot be separated from the source ceiling, and neither answer can be trusted.
nextStage: The product-proof freeze and the varied real-business corpus in docs/GENUINE_BUSINESS_ACCEPTANCE.md, which opens when a candidate legitimately clears the visual bar. Everything the freeze was waiting on that could be built has been built.
recentlyCompleted: declared-requirement consumers - conversion goals and hard constraints. primaryAction() collapsed call, email and contact form into one Call button on every route; conversionPlan() now resolves every declared goal and places channels by context, and nbm ships two channels plus a recorded gap where its sources hold no email address. manifest.constraints.hard had no reader at all and now has a coverage ledger that reports what enforces each constraint - 1 enforced, 3 routed to the producer that owns the evidence, 0 unclassified on nbm

nbm rerun on the fixed factory - 2 candidates, diversity distinct, 21 captures each with 21 distinct content hashes, DesignLint clean, route identity intact at desktop/tablet/mobile. The #163 capture fix and the #165 responsive fixes both survive a build that was not the one they were written against

first independent Phase 4D visual verdict — an OpenAI GPT-5 design-critic reviewed the nbm candidate set an Anthropic runtime created, and rejected both. The quality system worked: it found a defect the creator had missed and nothing was promoted

route-capture root cause — the evidence server answered every prerendered route with the home document, because it served a path only when that path was itself a file and a prerendered build answers /services with services/index.html. Six routes per viewport were photographed as one page. Reproduced against the frozen nbm inputs, fixed in document resolution rather than by a per-project special case, and proved by six distinct captures whose rendered page identity matches the route requested

4.2A implementation — static/content renderer; deterministic fail-closed renderer selection, six route documents and zero client JavaScript for the business the application renderer serves with one. Its independent visual review is outstanding above, so the stage is not closed
cross-browser visual portability lane; found and fixed a real defect on its first hosted run — the site header was not sticky on any phone
cross-build anti-template diagnostic; advisory by declaration, and it reports the cause of its own findings
controlled bespoke-presentation lane; project-local, token-only, section-scoped, durable across a rebuild and re-validated against the build it lands in

deferredCapabilities.title: Deterministic design-intelligence catalogue
deferredCapabilities.reason: No component asks "which reviewed design patterns fit this project?". BrandSpec reads the knowledge pack's own brand observations, ArtDirectionPlan reads config/layout-patterns.json, and the Presentation Registry is compiled from what the template renders. A catalogue built now would have one producer and no reader.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A real 4D consumer cannot answer a project/industry/intent pattern question from deterministic config. Then document that consumer first, and implement only the smallest lexical (BM25/keyword) catalogue it needs — no vector store, no embeddings, no generic design corpus.

deferredCapabilities.title: MessagingPlan
deferredCapabilities.reason: The composition already carries what a MessagingPlan would organise, with provenance. Page narrative is the section sequence; CTA strategy is derived from the declared conversion goals; proof requirements and their gaps are `declaredProofGap`; audience is on the manifest; forbidden claims are the existing source/provenance boundary. A second narrative authority would have fields nothing reads and a second place the same decision could be made.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: An art-direction or composition decision needs narrative information the composition cannot express — a proof sequence that does not follow from what is available, or an objection-handling order. Implement only the fields that decision reads.

deferredCapabilities.title: Visual comparison canvas
deferredCapabilities.reason: The ordinary Builder Console does the comparison: its candidate panel shows every candidate side by side, switches route and viewport over the captured evidence, names the axes that actually differ, shows the responsive plan and every DesignLint finding, exposes the scoped critic criteria, and promotes exactly one. The single usability failure found was the 330px activity sidebar cropping two full-page captures into roughly 150px columns; moving the panel to the builder stage fixed it. The failing surface was the narrow column, not the Console, so a canvas dependency would be bought against a layout problem.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A concrete comparison task proves the Console cannot do it — spatial arrangement of many more candidates, or freehand annotation a reviewer genuinely needs to hand back. Record the task first.

deferredCapabilities.title: Static semantic icons, Pagefind search, richer typed structured data, deterministic OG imagery
deferredCapabilities.reason: Each needs a real consumer first. The structured data the static renderer emits today is exactly what the factory already supported — a WebSite object, emitted only when the site's own URL is known — because inventing typed entities from facts nothing supports would be a fabricated observation.
deferredCapabilities.revivesWhen: A corpus project needs one of them and the absence is a recorded defect rather than a missing feature on a list. Implement only the one that project needed.
